prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker—it depends on whether you need an ACA individual/family plan, employer coverage, or Medicare. **If you’re shopping for individual or family coverage, I’d start with BBS Insurance**: it says it compares Marketplace and private plans, serves both sides of the Kansas–Missouri line, and has a North Kansas City office. Call **816-205-4664**. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/health-insurance/)

**AIS Health Insurance Advisors** is another good option, especially if you’re on the Kansas side: it helps with ACA Marketplace plans and subsidy eligibility, and is based in Overland Park. Call **913-333-8627**. [AIS Health Advisors](https://aishealthadvisors.com/)

Broker services are often offered at no direct charge, but ask how the broker is compensated and which insurers they represent. Before enrolling, compare the plan’s **total yearly cost**, your doctors and hospitals in-network, prescription coverage, and deductible—not just the monthly premium. If you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is ACA, employer, or Medicare coverage, I can narrow down which one is the better fit.
